headline: Is your culture keeping pace with your business ambition?
summary: Sushil Baveja, CHRO of Jindal Stainless, emphasizes that organizational culture must be regularly reviewed alongside traditional financial and operational performance metrics. As companies scale, existing cultural norms can become constraints unless leadership proactively adapts them to support expanding business ambitions. Consequently, cultural assessments should be integrated directly into routine strategic reviews rather than treated as an isolated HR task.

headline: JPMorgan employee’s free run club generates over Rs 6.1 crore in one year
summary: JPMorgan employee Owen Akhibi built a social-fitness community called Peak and Pace, which generated over $640,000 in revenue in 2025 while keeping its core running events free. The venture monetizes through ticketed social parties and trips, achieving a 15% profit margin that is entirely reinvested into the business. Akhibi scaled the network to over 30,000 attendees in 2025 while managing his full-time role in algorithmic trading sales.

headline: Mukta D Sharma takes charge as group CHRO across Asian Energy Services, Oilmax, Anirit and Kuper
summary: Mukta D Sharma has been appointed as the Group Chief Human Resources Officer across Asian Energy Services, Oilmax, Anirit, and Kuper, effective September 2026. Bringing over 17 years of HR leadership experience from companies like Thermax, Eaton, and Honeywell, she will drive group-level people strategy and leadership capability. Her background spans HR operations, industrial relations, and talent management across the engineering and manufacturing sectors.

headline: How CIIAO values guide Vedanta Group’s workplace culture
summary: Vedanta Group has aligned its workplace culture with its core CIIAO values to prioritize employee mental and emotional well-being across its operations. The conglomerate provides structured support through confidential counseling, progressive transition programs for returning mothers, and dedicated monthly self-care remote work options for female staff. These initiatives aim to build an inclusive environment that balances professional responsibilities with holistic employee health.

headline: Pinjarkar to lead enterprise growth at Native, as managing partner & head
summary: Human resources services firm Native has appointed Rahul Pinjarkar as managing partner and head of enterprise growth. Pinjarkar brings over two decades of HR leadership experience from prominent roles at organizations such as Tata Chemicals, Saint-Gobain, and Novartis India. In his new assignment, he will drive scale and growth strategy across Native's portfolio of group companies.

headline: HR’s credibility is tested after the complaint is filed
summary: Following allegations that past complaints against a manager yielded no consequences, Genpact launched an independent review into its internal grievance processes. The case highlights the structural tension HR departments face between ensuring due process for the accused and maintaining credibility with complainants. Ultimately, lengthy and opaque investigation timelines can leave employees feeling unprotected, eroding trust in corporate reporting systems.

headline: Genpact employees allege gender bias, harassment and excessive work hours; company orders review
summary: Employees at Genpact's Hyderabad facility have alleged severe workplace issues, including gender discrimination, excessive working hours, and harassment by local management. Following viral social media footage of an internal meeting detailing these complaints, the company announced it has initiated an independent internal review.
